title: Canonical finite etale base-change functor
statement: For any morphism g:Y' -> Y of schemes [def-pc-scheme], there exist a functor F from finite etale Y-schemes [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category] to finite etale descent data relative to g [def-galois-finite-etale-descent-data], and first projections q_P, such that each image is the pullback of P along g [def-pc-fibre-product], transport [def-pd-descent-datum] preserves q_P, and F maps morphisms to their base changes. No covering hypothesis is required.

source.place: Proof; corrected Stacks route recorded in node lem-galois-descent

proof.text: For each finite etale P, take its pullback and second projection, finite etale by stability under base change.
Define transport by keeping the first projection and replacing the second by the new point of the base. Pullback uniqueness proves naturality, identity, and cocycle.
Pull back morphisms; pullback uniqueness proves compatibility and the functor laws. First projections give all the equations.
